text:
anya: Heads-up: deploy-bot detected embeddings p95 spike after merge to release/v2.5.2. Holding promotion.
deploy-bot: AUTOPAUSE: Canary suspended. Metric: embeddings.p95_latency > threshold. Suggested: investigate or pin.
sam: Do we want auto rollback or manual handling so we don't hit dedicated pools?
lee: Manual pin for hosted endpoints only, avoid touching dedicated.
anya: Agreed. Pin hosted embeddings to v2.5.1 and keep 1% canary on v2.5.2. Suppress auto-rollback.
ops-runner: Executing:
```
routerctl pin --route embeddings --target-tag v2.5.1 --canary 1 --reason "p95 spike after v2.5.2"
```
ops-runner: Pin applied. Traffic: 99%->v2.5.1, 1% canary. Auto-rollback suppressed.
sre-jen: Metrics show KV eviction spike at time of merge. Possible kv-cache format mismatch. Opening INF-1810.
maria: Can ops run smoke and a small quality sample? Need latency and vector-drift checks.
ops-runner: Smoke: login OK, embeddings-create latency back to baseline (~230ms), sample quality shows 2/100 minor drift. No customer-impacting errors.
sam: Latency acceptable for now. What's rollback criteria if this persists?
anya: If embeddings.p95 > 500ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, trigger targeted rollback to v2.5.0 for embeddings.
lee: Prepare rollback playbook and notify CSE draft.
kate: Drafting customer advisory: "Temporary routing pin to previous version for embeddings due to elevated latency; monitoring." Will queue for 15m stability.
sre-jen: I'll own INF-1810 and add KV compatibility test to post-merge CI.
ops-runner: Follow-up after pin: p95 at 220ms, sample checks good. Keeping suppression for 45m.
anya: Thanks. Keep thread updated. We'll reopen if telemetry changes. :thumbsup:
